lineage.source: main_case_lineage_2026_10_05/derived/v5_summary.json (sets.set.arms.<arm>: band_bn, c3_line, counts), re-based on main_case_2026_10_15/derived/summary.json (v8.companions), independently rerun native caseOf options

rebase.source: main_case_2026_10_15/derived/summary.json (v8.companions), independently rerun native caseOf options
rebase.rule: Native whole-case bands at all four options gated 1e-9. C3 error uses symmetric +/-SE secant [APPROX], not an affine identity; nonlinear midpoint residual retained. Arms a/c scale this secant by native G3-rate counts [APPROX]; coverage prices fixed as producer declares.

pension_switch.rule: the union-side identities on v6's meta.pension_accrual: social_security less the lineage's (its cells and the items' lineage_* parts) is ratio_net x the union's OASDI receipts, and medicare less the lineage's, less part_a_accrual_bn, is (1 - part_a_share) of the cash set's union amount (1e-9); the lineage's social_security moves with its own OASDI receipts at k, and its Part A accrual is fixed like the union's

union_completion.rule: R11: these source-priced native cells enter through item 10's producer stack; original pension identities/rules remain unchanged after their explicit subtraction

row4_frame.rule: R9: subtract named union parts before v6 identity checks; actual union SS shifts follow OASDI receipts and Part A shifts are fixed; lineage parts keep their own accrual ratio/fixed Part A

items.route: the lineage's cells, re-valued in place, ride each line's first-order ratio as v5's do [ASSUMPTION, oct05's]
the case's group total uses its personal specifications (R5)
source PES 0.53-point SE through producer derivative

capital.route: each offset's key is its carrier's share, a fixed key shift the item sets: it enters the capital return's rebuild (kcoef_<tag>_share_<carrier>) and carries no sampling error [ASSUMPTION: v4's rule for correction lines the uncorrected model lacks]

source.verdict: Taxes on the business capital that serves the group's jobs come to **$66.5bn a year at the band's low end

source_se_bn.rule: SDR over the 160 replicate weights (the CPS sample); fill_in from the fill-in rel_change SE

job_capital_sampling.rule: producer's 161-weight vectors, points and per-line/joint SDR gated against item.json (1e-9); corporate's two lines share one vector; joint with the account and benefit keys at matching pwwgt columns; lineage dollars ride the line's first-order ratio [ASSUMPTION]; v8's foreign-source shifts are removed from that ratio and its exact signed K2 producer vector enters instead

production.scope: generation-end P/F ratio on that generation's existing earnings-key price pieces

decomposition.sign_convention: capital, fiscal lines and unclassified are net costs; P and F are signed welfare/receipt gains; total = capital + fiscal lines + unclassified - P - F
decomposition.borrowing_rule: capital return and private P are not borrowing; unclassified residual/calibration/post-engine amounts require the consumer's declared financing rule

low.adult_minor_uncertainty_rule: conditional CPS price/weight replication; missing-count assumptions are construction sensitivities, not observed counts or an estimated missing-count SE

high.adult_minor_uncertainty_rule: conditional CPS price/weight replication; missing-count assumptions are construction sensitivities, not observed counts or an estimated missing-count SE

coverage.companion_rule: carried from central; no own-price coverage rerun
source_limitations: PES household-to-resident and Hispanic-to-Mexican-origin transfer assumptions
birth/arrival dates inside public-use bands modelled; missed-member survival/emigration unobserved
within-G3+ pricing proxy and per-head calibration separate exact net totals
denominator arm holds composite receipt coefficients and case responses fixed; not an engine rerun
CPS replicate SE excludes PES covariance, DA series range and transfer uncertainty

pes_sampling.source: 2020 PES Hispanic overall NCE SE, pinned Census Table C and national positive control
pes_sampling.covariance_rule: [APPROX] one common absolute Hispanic NCE-fraction shock to all PES-priced age/sex cells; DA-priced children and 2024 controls fixed. Shape uncertainty is excluded. Consumer treats this scalar instrument as independent of CPS.
pes_sampling.derivative_method: producer factors/evaluate; centred differences at h=1e-4 and 1e-5, Richardson extrapolation, independent check at h=1e-6

set.method: current bytes match original frozen recipe

cash.method: current bytes match original frozen recipe

pes_sampling.derivative_axis: signed source NCE fraction (nce_pct/100); increasing it makes negative net coverage error less negative and reduces priced omission. A positive undercount-fraction shock has the opposite sign.

v8_sampling.rule: K2, item 10 paired own-record CPS stack, item 11 round2 stack and conditional coverage CPS construction join the account and benefit keys at matching pwwgt0..160, preserving covariance. Source policy/count calibrations are fixed. Coverage uses external PES 0.53-point SE times the declared derivative, independent of CPS; no account-key spread substitutes for an item's producer spread.

coverage_cps.rule: conditional source CPS construction, producer calibrated prices/model held; shared vectors retain covariance with main CPS blocks; PES instrument remains separate
coverage_cps.frame_proof: canonical PH_SEQ/PPPOS weights equal official main CPS zip in every pwwgt0..160 column; native row4 calibration retained

v8_sampling.transport: Producer item-10 and coverage CPS endpoint vectors carried by reading over the 32 personal specifications [APPROX]; producer responses/calibrations held. K2 and item-11 exact source stacks gated at 1e-9.
v8_sampling.interval_scope: [CONDITIONAL APPROXIMATION] common absolute Hispanic NCE shock through pinned producer functions; DA children fixed. No official age/sex covariance or unconditional interval.
